title: TypeScript Base App Completion, Cleanup & Canonical Convergence
objective: Deep-clean and finish the recovered Merge83 TypeScript base app so every production feature/function is implemented, verified, intentionally removed, or explicitly represented by a roadmap subgoal; converge the chat-first Zero/Go/Hub architecture and shared runtimes without parallel legacy authorities; converge the Phia-derived Titan Decision Engine into the TypeScript base as a governed, continuously observing business-decision runtime with active evidence acquisition, temporal re-evaluation, persistent decision-object memory, ecosystem intelligence and authority-separated execution.
manager_only_reason: Goal 52 is the Mesh Manager control-plane and TypeScript base-app convergence gate. Builders must not claim, execute, reserve, or modify any Goal 52 subgoal. Builder implementation work belongs in other eligible roadmap subgoals and is brought here only as evidence/deltas for Manager convergence.

manager_pass_protocol.purpose: Provide one recurring Manager-only control loop for base-app convergence, delta intake, canonical reconciliation, roadmap integrity and corrective work.
pass_sequence: PREPASS: resolve Manager role, latest canonical, BASELINE, ROUND-CONTROL, sync state, active claims, merge queue and conflicts
EVERY_PASS: deep-scan relevant Agent Mesh state, revalidate the current canonical/base, inspect active Builder work and detect collisions, stale references, misplaced deltas and incomplete handoffs
EVERY_PASS: reconcile eligible evidence against Goal 52 and update only the authoritative roadmap/control-plane records using version-bound CAS/rebase

EVERY_5TH_PASS: perform a formal DELTA_QUEUE_CONVERGENCE checkpoint — deep-scan the authoritative Manager delta queue plus legacy/misplaced delta locations, validate receipts/lineage/base compatibility, merge all eligible final cumulative deltas, resolve conflicts, run reconstruction/verification, update merge receipts and canonical promotion state as appropriate, and clear only consumed/validated queue entries

EVERY_6TH_PASS: perform a Manager corrective/maintenance pass — address any control-plane defect, roadmap inconsistency, stale canonical pointer, misplaced artifact, failed verification, unresolved collision, missing traceability, security/privacy issue, regression or other Manager-owned task discovered during the preceding five-pass cycle
ON_CANONICAL_CHANGE: refresh Manager BASELINE, canonical pointers, integrity/hash evidence, dependency/feature traceability and affected Builder guidance before allowing subsequent convergence
ON_SUBGOAL_COMPLETION: verify acceptance evidence, confirm no missing feature/function remains unexplained, reconcile final delta, update roadmap state, and only then mark the subgoal COMPLETE
ON_NO_QUEUE_WORK: do not manufacture merges; use the pass for deep audit, repair, verification, roadmap hygiene, reference-library reconciliation or another concrete Manager-owned task

NEVER: let Builder ownership enter Goal 52, blindly stack midpoint checkpoints, promote an unverified build, overwrite a newer roadmap with stale content, or leave duplicate canonical/roadmap authorities active

Latest-base revalidation before every convergence decision
Agent Mesh control-plane health and synchronization audit

Authoritative delta queue intake, lineage and receipt validation
Misplaced/legacy delta discovery and safe reconciliation
Final cumulative delta merge and reconstruction verification
Canonical promotion/release gate management
Roadmap single-source-of-truth and stale-reference cleanup
Feature/function-to-roadmap traceability audit
Base-app integration and dependency consistency audit
Security, privacy, authority and company_id boundary audit
Regression/test evidence review and unresolved-failure triage
Performance/startup/PWA integration regression review
Reference Library freshness and donor-lineage reconciliation
Conflict resolution and semantic convergence across parallel work
Documentation/control-plane cleanup
Backup/recovery/checkpoint integrity verification
Manager receipts, audit trail and provenance maintenance
Post-merge smoke/regression verification
Roadmap state/priority/subgoal hygiene and evidence-based gap creation
Select and coordinate the next eligible Builder work outside Goal 52 without taking ownership of Builder implementation
manager_pass_protocol.queue_rule: Only the authoritative Manager delta queue is a merge authority. Legacy/misplaced queues are discovery/provenance sources and may be reconciled into the authoritative queue or directly converged only under Manager verification.
manager_pass_protocol.merge_cadence: Every 5th Manager pass, with an immediate earlier convergence if safety, integrity, release, dependency or queue pressure requires it.
manager_pass_protocol.corrective_cadence: Every 6th Manager pass, following the fifth-pass convergence checkpoint, unless an urgent corrective action is required sooner.

goal_claim_rule: Goals are not claimable; Builders claim subgoals only and proceed immediately under lease.
library_reuse_refs: Merge83 recovered staging donor (historical provenance only; GitHub main is canonical)
agent_goal_rule: Reuse canonical workforce identities; create no surface-specific duplicate agents.
workforce_goal_rule: Workforce features are projections of canonical agents and authority, not separate app-local workers.
